name: Gesban
title: One of David's heroes
summary: Gesban (also known as Jashen or Hashem) was the father of several of David's mighty warriors. His sons are mentioned among the thirty heroes who served King David with great bravery. His family is known for their military skill and loyalty to David.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Gesban is mentioned as the father of heroes who served among David's thirty mighty men, an elite group of warriors distinguished in battle.

keyEvents.title: The Sons in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Gesban's sons (here called Hashem from Gizon) are listed among David's brave men who formed his closest warrior force.

keyEvents.title: David's Elite Group of Thirty Heroes
keyEvents.description: David's thirty heroes were a chosen group of warriors who had shown exceptional bravery and loyalty. Gesban's sons were part of this honored group.

keyEvents.title: David's Mighty Men Gather
keyEvents.description: David's mighty men gathered around him during his time as king and helped strengthen and defend his kingdom through many wars.
